nodes.summary: The resolvent-type factorization behind the spectral mapping: for `μ ≠ 1` and `λ = i * (1 + μ) / (1 - μ)`, `μ • 1 - U = ((μ - 1) • (A - λ • 1)) * (A + i • 1)⁻¹`.
nodes.title: Resolvent factorization for the Cayley transform

nodes.summary: The Cayley transform of an operator `A`: `(A - i) * (A + i)⁻¹`. The factor `A + i • 1` is a unit when `A` is self-adjoint on a complete Hilbert space (see `isUnit_add_I_smul_one_of_isSelfAdjoint` below), in which case the ring inverse here is the genuine operator inverse.
nodes.title: Cayley transform of an operator

nodes.summary: The two factors of the Cayley transform commute.
nodes.title: Factors of the Cayley transform commute

nodes.summary: The inverse Cayley formula: `A = i • (1 + U) * (1 - U)⁻¹`.
nodes.title: Inverse Cayley formula

nodes.summary: The preimage direction of the spectral mapping: every point of the spectrum of `U` is `(w - i) / (w + i)` for some `w` in the spectrum of `A`.
nodes.title: Spectral mapping for the Cayley transform, preimage direction

nodes.summary: The eigenvalue correspondence: for `μ ≠ 1`, `μ` is an eigenvalue of the Cayley transform `U` iff `i * (1 + μ) / (1 - μ)` is an eigenvalue of `A`.
nodes.title: Eigenvalues of the Cayley transform

nodes.summary: For a self-adjoint operator, `A + i • 1` is a unit.
nodes.title: Self-adjoint operator plus $i$ is invertible

nodes.summary: The Cayley transform of a self-adjoint operator is a unit.
nodes.title: Cayley transform of a self-adjoint operator is invertible

nodes.summary: `1 - U` is a unit for the Cayley transform of a self-adjoint operator: `1` is never in the spectrum of `U`.
nodes.title: One minus the Cayley transform is invertible

nodes.summary: The inverse of `A + i • 1` is a unit for self-adjoint `A`.
nodes.title: Inverse of a self-adjoint operator plus $i$ is a unit

nodes.summary: A nonzero scalar operator is a unit.
nodes.title: Nonzero scalar operators are units

nodes.summary: For a self-adjoint operator, `A - i • 1` is a unit.
nodes.title: Self-adjoint operator minus $i$ is invertible

nodes.summary: For a self-adjoint operator, `A - w • 1` is a unit whenever `w` has nonzero imaginary part. The proof is the norm estimate `‖(A - w • 1) x‖ ≥ |w.im| * ‖x‖`, read off from the imaginary part of `⟪(A - w • 1) x, x⟫`.
nodes.title: Self-adjoint operator minus a non-real scalar is invertible

nodes.summary: The image direction of the spectral mapping: if `w` is in the spectrum of `A`, then `(w - i) / (w + i)` is in the spectrum of `U`.
nodes.title: Spectral mapping for the Cayley transform, image direction

nodes.summary: The Cayley transform of a self-adjoint operator is unitary.
nodes.title: Cayley transform of a self-adjoint operator is unitary

nodes.summary: The Cayley transform of a self-adjoint operator satisfies `U * U† = 1`.
nodes.title: Adjoint of the Cayley transform is a right inverse

nodes.summary: The Cayley transform of a self-adjoint operator is an isometry.
nodes.title: Cayley transform preserves norms of vectors

nodes.summary: On a nontrivial space, the Cayley transform has operator norm `1`.
nodes.title: Operator norm of the Cayley transform is one

nodes.summary: Points of the spectrum of the Cayley transform lie on the unit circle.
nodes.title: Spectrum of the Cayley transform lies on the unit circle

nodes.summary: `1 + U` is `2 • A` times the inverse of `A + i • 1`.
nodes.title: Formula for one plus the Cayley transform

nodes.summary: `1` is never in the spectrum of the Cayley transform.
nodes.title: One is not in the spectrum of the Cayley transform

nodes.summary: `1 - U` is `2 • (i • 1)` times the inverse of `A + i • 1`.
nodes.title: Formula for one minus the Cayley transform

nodes.summary: The ring inverse of a scalar operator is the scalar operator of the inverse scalar.
nodes.title: Inverse of a scalar operator

nodes.summary: The spectrum of the Cayley transform is the image of the spectrum of `A` under the Möbius map `λ ↦ (λ - i) / (λ + i)`.
nodes.title: Spectrum of the Cayley transform

nodes.summary: The adjoint of the Cayley transform.
nodes.title: Adjoint of the Cayley transform

nodes.summary: The Cayley transform of a self-adjoint operator satisfies `U† * U = 1`.
nodes.title: Adjoint of the Cayley transform is a left inverse

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
